description: Bridge and culvert restrictions is a dataset listed in Peclet Queensland open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Transport and Main Roads. Information on bridge restrictions can be found on the TMR website at The page provides a range of maps, and the information can also be downloaded as PDF or KMZ. Coverage: Queensland. The portal files it under Transport, Movements. Its keywords are Bridge restrictions, Low bridges, Height restrictions, heavy vehicles. The portal shows 1,181 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-08-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-queensland-portal.
